blocks.value: Delivery investing means buying shares to keep them for more than one trading day. The shares are delivered to your Demat Account.
Imagine This: Buying a house to live in for many years is very different from buying it in the morning and selling it in the evening. Delivery investing follows the first approach.
Most long-term investors use CNC (Cash and Carry) or Delivery mode because they intend to hold shares for weeks, months, or even years.
You buy 20 shares of Infosys today and decide to keep them for five years. This is delivery investing.
Long-term wealth is generally created through patient investing rather than frequent trading.
